answer_1.quote: We propose a new task of contextual security policy preservation against attacks in LLMs, aiming for real-world applications.
answer_1.outputs: LLM-generated answers to user queries under security policies

answer_2.quote: We employ a hybrid evaluation strategy in which LLM-based evaluation is applied to the entire dataset...

answer_3.quote: We adopt an LLM-as-judge evaluator to assess model outputs, using it both for detecting leakage and for measuring faithfulness.

answer_4.quote: Human validation was conducted on 84 attack QA pairs sampled from the full CoPriva dataset. The validation was performed by three speakers who are fluent at English, following the same criteria used in the LLM-based automatic filtering and evaluation stages.
answer_4.guideline: following the same criteria used in the LLM-based automatic filtering and evaluation stages
